card.name: Separator inside confidence interval ranges
card.fires_on: The comma, dash or word "to" that sits between the lower and upper bounds of a confidence interval, right after a lower bound below 1 such as 0.68 or 0.77.

modes.label: Comma between bounds
modes.description: A comma separates the two ends of a 95% CI after a hazard ratio.

modes.label: Dash or "to" between bounds
modes.description: A dash or the word "to" joins the lower and upper bounds of an interval.
